neighbours.label: a mid-clause habituality marker stating what is typically the case ('are usually accompanied' 0.17, 'Many students lack' in the card); sentence-initial 'Typically,'/'Generally,' (0.01-0.07), 'always' (0.09) and the exception markers 'Surprisingly'/'Unfortunately' (0.01) are silent in short sentences, so the unit needs a preceding sentence
fire: The letters come from strangers. They usually ask for money rather than advice.
I have seen many of these cases. The symptoms typically fade within a week.
Insurance rules vary by state. Premiums are generally not deductible for individuals.
Not every patient reacts the same way. In most cases the muscle recovers on its own.
Discounts look generous at first. Normally the marked-down items are the ones nobody wants.
The rumours sounded dramatic. They usually turn out to be nothing more than gossip.
Long novels defeat many pupils. Most of them lack the stamina to finish one.
Cough syrups are sold everywhere. They typically contain a decongestant as well.

Long novels defeat many pupils. This one never finished the assigned reading.
